title: Pure Koala
summary: Chumley Huffington's Koala Beast-Fusion strategy, combining Level 2 EARTH/WATER Beast swarmers (Sea Koala, Tree Otter, and Valerifawn) with the 4200 ATK Fusion boss Master of Oz. Rescue Cat, Obedience Schooled, and Fusion Deployment pull the named Beast materials directly from the Deck while King of the Swamp bridges into Polymerization.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rescue Cat sends itself to the GY to Special Summon two Level 3 or lower Beast monsters (Sea Koala, Tree Otter, or Des Koala) directly from the Deck.

Obedience Schooled (Limited) Special Summons three Level 2 or lower Beast Effect Monsters with different names (Sea Koala, Tree Otter, and Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest) from the Deck when you control no monsters.
Fusion Deployment reveals Master of Oz or Koalo-Koala in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, Sea Koala, or Tree Otter from the hand or Deck.
King of the Swamp discards itself to search Polymerization, or serves as a Fusion Substitute for Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, Sea Koala, or Tree Otter.

summary.title: Opening: Rescue Cat or Fusion Deployment + King of the Swamp
steps: Normal Summon Rescue Cat and send it to the GY to Special Summon Sea Koala and Tree Otter from the Deck; going second, use Sea Koala to reduce an opposing monster's ATK to 0 and Tree Otter to boost another Beast by 1000 ATK.

Fuse Sea Koala and Tree Otter with Polymerization into Koalo-Koala, or overlay them into Melffy of the Forest (which searches a Beast monster and negates an opposing monster) or Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu.
Alternatively, activate Fusion Deployment to summon Big Koala from the Deck and fuse it with King of the Swamp via Polymerization into the 4200 ATK Master of Oz.

summary.title: Sea Koala, Tree Otter & Koala Control
summary.text: While you control another Beast monster, Sea Koala drops any opposing monster's ATK to 0 until the End Phase, letting Master of Oz deal 4200 battle damage in a single attack or Vampiric Koala gain massive LP from battle damage. Des Koala punishes large hands with 400 burn damage per card when flipped face-up, and Des Kangaroo destroys any attacker whose ATK is lower than its 1700 DEF.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Master of Oz (Big Koala + Des Kangaroo) brings 4200 ATK and 3700 DEF to run over anything on the board and close games alongside Sea Koala and Tree Otter.
Koalo-Koala (Sea Koala + Tree Otter) sends a Beast monster from your hand to the GY to target and destroy a monster the opponent controls.

Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while you control another Beast and detaches to summon a Kagemusha Raccoon Token copying the highest ATK on the field, including Master of Oz's 4200 ATK.

Note: Obedience Schooled locks you into Beast-Type Special Summons for the turn and Fusion Deployment locks your Extra Deck to Fusion Monsters for the turn, so sequence Rank 2 Xyz plays and Fusion plays accordingly.

summary.title: Spells
points: Ayers Rock Sunrise revives any Beast monster—including Master of Oz, Koalo-Koala, Big Koala, or Sea Koala—from the GY and lowers all opposing monsters' ATK by 200 per Beast in your GY.
Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest discards a card to revive a Level 2 or lower Beast in Attack or face-down Defense Position.

main: Sea Koala

Core Level 2 EARTH Beast: once per turn while you control another Beast monster, targets 1 monster your opponent controls and reduces its ATK to 0 until the End Phase; also the named Fusion Material for Koalo-Koala!
Des Koala
Chumley's signature Level 3 DARK Beast Flip monster (1800 DEF) that inflicts 400 burn damage to your opponent for each card in their hand when flipped face-up.
Big Koala
Level 7 EARTH Beast Normal Monster with 2700 ATK / 2000 DEF; summoned directly from the Deck via Fusion Deployment and serves as the named Fusion Material for Master of Oz.
Des Kangaroo
Level 4 DARK Beast (1500 ATK / 1700 DEF) that destroys any monster that attacks it with lower ATK than its DEF, and serves as the named Fusion Material for Master of Oz.
Tree Otter
Level 2 WATER Beast that gives another Beast monster +1000 ATK while you control another Beast, and is the second named Fusion Material for Koalo-Koala!
Vampiric Koala
Level 4 EARTH Beast (1800 ATK) that gains LP equal to the battle damage it inflicts to your opponent when battling a monster.
Rescue Cat
Sends itself to the GY to Special Summon Sea Koala + Tree Otter from your Deck—reducing an opponent's monster to 0 ATK with Sea Koala and boosting by 1000 ATK with Tree Otter!
Obedience Schooled
Limited to 1 in TCG: summons Sea Koala, Tree Otter, and Valerifawn directly from the Deck to assemble Rank 2 Beasts or tribute/fuse under its Beast-only lock.
Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest
Level 2 EARTH Beast summoned by Obedience Schooled that revives Sea Koala or sets Des Koala face-down from your GY.
King of the Swamp
Substitutes for Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, Sea Koala, or Tree Otter, or discards itself to search Polymerization.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Master of Oz or Koalo-Koala in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Big Koala, Des Kangaroo, Sea Koala, or Tree Otter directly from your Deck!
Polymerization
Fuses Big Koala + Des Kangaroo into Master of Oz, or Sea Koala + Tree Otter into Koalo-Koala.
Ayers Rock Sunrise
Revives Master of Oz, Koalo-Koala, Big Koala, or Sea Koala from your GY and drops all opponent's monsters' ATK.
